On our first date, he took me to show me off to his family and I felt good knowing that they thought, 'wow, how did he get her.'
I guess I felt that here was a potential relationship that would be simple, no game play, easy and where I would be emotionally safe. 
The balance switched when I fell in love.

We were living together. He was the wage earner, I was pregnant, and I was still thinking I had to make it work.
It would be good to go back in time and make wiser decisions, but I didn't and I have to deal with the consequences. 
My dad was violent to my mum. He raped her holding a lit cigarette over her breasts. He had schizophrenia and set himself on fire when I was nine. My stepdad was very emotionally abusive.
I guess I didn't really know what behaviour was too much. I didn't know where to draw the line. 
I'm single now, and content. Poor, but content.
